data.title: Bank asks for ID copy and self-disclosure form
data.summary: Muster Bank AG asks David Muster to update his customer data under the Money Laundering Act (Geldwäschegesetz). He must send an ID copy and the completed self-disclosure form within 8 working days of the letter date (18 December 2025).
data.explanation: Your bank is legally required to update your customer details regularly. Send a copy of your valid ID and the completed self-disclosure form (Selbstauskunftsbogen). The deadline is 8 working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays) counted from the letter date; the app shows the date. If you miss it, the bank will block your securities account (Depot) for purchases until this is sorted out. Check the request is genuine by contacting the bank through its known contact channels before sending your ID.
